mathematical_carrier.level1: apply same causal low-node turning-point operator to S0; S1=level1-wave low skeleton; C1=S0-S1
mathematical_carrier.level2: apply same causal low-node turning-point operator to S1; S2=level2-wave low skeleton; C2=S1-S2

coarsening_kernel.reason: nearest causal coarsening on an already wave-sampled node stream; not a target period

mathematical_carrier.period: median of up to last 3 completed waves in that level; one completed wave is minimum availability
mathematical_carrier.direction: active leg from last confirmed pivot kind: low->UP, high->DOWN
mathematical_carrier.phase: causal age/current recent period: EARLY<1/3, MIDDLE<2/3, else LATE

fidelity_gate.A: at least 200 same-scale pair decisions with resolved C1 and >=20% C1 coverage
fidelity_gate.B: at least 200 closed baseline trade decisions with both C1/C2 resolved and >=20% joint coverage

A.unit: same-scale strict base pair at current wave confirmation
A.target: new C1 turning pivot occurrence strictly after decision within ceil(0.5*T1), settled by a later confirmed pivot beyond horizon
A.walk_forward: train <= prior years with labels matured before first calendar bar of test year; test 2018,2019,2020
A.estimator: nested empirical probability with alpha=20 fixed
A.acceptance: A2 vs A0 relative Brier improvement >=1%, lower LogLoss, >=2 test years same direction, moving-block 97.5% interval lower>0

B.unit: fixed T0 raw-close breakout opportunity, next raw open fill; T0=ceil median base-wave duration in 2015-2017

financial_regimes.C1_RISKY: low-tertile A2/A1 and (C1 opposed OR C1 LATE)
financial_regimes.C2_SUPPORTIVE: high-tertile A2/A1 and C2 aligned and C2 not LATE

B.acceptance: B2 vs B0 relative Brier improvement >=1%, lower LogLoss, >=2 years same direction, moving-block 97.5% interval lower>0, and C1_RISKY fast-loss > C2_SUPPORTIVE

inference.time_blocks: 20 trading sessions; outcomes crossing block boundary excluded only from interval estimation
inference.bootstrap: circular moving blocks of 2 adjacent 20-session blocks
